labeling_policy.continuity_rule: Do not decide continuity from elapsed seconds alone. Treat a short interruption as the same appearance only when the same person remains visually continuous across it; otherwise split.
labeling_policy.partial_visibility_rule: Include time where the target remains identifiable despite partial visibility. Exclude frames where identity is not visually identifiable unless continuity across the interruption is independently confirmed.
labeling_policy.unknown_rule: Unreviewed gaps are unknown and must not be used as positive merge Authority.

gap_labels.label: same_appearance
gap_labels.authority: DIAG-2 Build 35 visual continuity PASS plus user visual confirmation

gap_labels.label: unknown
gap_labels.authority: Not visually reviewed; must remain split in Corrective 1 fixture

notes: Full 27-minute appearance interval labeling is still required before the five-metric real-video quality gate can issue a formal PASS.
Corrective 1 unit fixtures may use the confirmed central gap but must not infer labels for unknown gaps.
